other_failure_modes.name: Implicit feature ordering dependence
other_failure_modes.description: The code relies on the implicit ordering of columns in the dataframe to reshape flat features into a 2D spatial grid. If columns in the dataset are not perfectly ordered as expected by the reshape operation, the spatial structure will be scrambled and the derived features will be nonsensical.

summary: The agent provides a strong solution with sophisticated, domain-specific feature engineering for the connect-4 board and robust cross-validation. However, it blindly relies on accuracy without checking for class imbalance, uses naive equal-weight ensembling for its CV folds, and implicitly assumes a specific column ordering for its spatial reshaping logic which could easily break.
